function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The original analysis incorrectly removed refunded orders, which changed the denominator from all loyal customers to only those with completed orders. However, the question asks for the fraction of loyal customers who converted, and the `converted` column is defined as 1 if the order completed checkout — which includes refunded orders that were initially completed. Therefore, the correct denominator is all loyal customers, regardless of status. I re-ran the analysis using all loyal customers (including refunded ones), and computed the fraction of those who converted (i.e., `converted == 1`). This now correctly reflects the intended estimand: the conversion rate among all loyal customers, as defined by the `converted` flag."}
function.name: resolve_finding
